channel.title: The Motley Fool UK - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Motley Fool UK (fool.co.uk)

item.title: Is the countdown really on for the Lloyds share price reaching £1?
item.description: The Lloyds Banking Group share price is looking ever more likely to end the year on a high, but I'm more interested in the long term.

item.title: Prudential’s sub-£11 share price looks a bargain to me, but how cheap is it?
item.description: Prudential’s share price has risen a lot over the year, but Simon Watkins believes there’s still a big gap between its current level and its ‘fair value’.

item.title: How much do you need in FTSE 100 income stocks to generate £777 a month for retirement?
item.description: Harvey Jones says dividend income stocks are a great way to generate long-term wealth, and picks out two with solid yields and healthy share price growth.

item.title: This ETF returned 8.4% last month while the FTSE 100 and S&P 500 indexes were flat
item.description: Last month, this niche exchange-traded fund (ETF) crushed the FTSE and most other major stock market indexes. Is it worth a closer look today?

item.title: Thank goodness I didn’t invest anything in Aston Martin shares at IPO
item.description: Aston Martin shares haven't exactly set the world alight since the company's IPO. But is there a bargain to be had today in the car manufacturer?

item.title: How much do you need in an ISA or SIPP to generate a £9,999 a year second income?
item.description: Harvey Jones shows how much investors need to generate a solid second income stream in retirement, and names a top FTSE 100 dividend stock to consider.

item.title: This 34p penny share could rocket 117%, says 1 broker
item.description: While this UK penny share is down 91% since 2021, one analyst team thinks it's now far too cheap at just 34p. Is it worth a punt?

item.title: Just released: the 3 best growth-focused stocks to consider buying in December [PREMIUM PICKS]
item.description: Our goal here is to highlight some of our past recommendations that we think are of particular interest today, due to a combination of business performance and potentially attractive share valuation.

item.title: Forget NIO stock! This company is rapidly becoming the ‘Tesla of China’
item.description: NIO stock hasn’t gone on to deliver the blockbuster returns that investors were expecting. But this Chinese EV stock looks capable of providing big gains.

item.title: FTSE 100 vs S&P 500: here's how £10k invested at the start of the year compares
item.description: Jon Smith reveals the result of a very tight race between the FTSE 100 and the US stock market benchmark and picks one of his favourite shares for next year.
